findings.description: The real CLI followed redirects while carrying the custom admin header.
findings.resolution: Add a release-smoke CLI mode that disables redirects, reject redirect responses in the canonical client, and prove no second request occurs.

findings.description: Browser routing allowed off-policy non-API traffic and exposed the app password to served JavaScript.
findings.resolution: Authenticate directly to the exact no-redirect API, verify the server cookie attributes, block all off-policy HTTP(S) origins and browser writes, and require an exact successful navigation.

findings.description: Mutation authorization had no protected production target-ID deny registry.
findings.resolution: Require nonempty protected production identity and origin registries and reject any staging or ephemeral identity/origin intersection.

findings.description: The detached release stamp allowed attached HEAD and untracked build inputs.
findings.resolution: Require detached HEAD and a completely clean tracked/untracked checkout before creating the stamp.

findings.description: The release manifest omitted generated PWA, Workbox, and other emitted JavaScript.
findings.resolution: Generate the release inventory after PWA output and verify it exactly matches every built JavaScript file.

findings.description: Loaded HTML and inline scripts were absent from retired-route scanning.
findings.resolution: Bound and scan the loaded document in addition to every verified JavaScript asset and observed request.

findings.description: Missing or invalid evidence was skipped rather than replaced and retained as a safe failure.
findings.resolution: Discard rejected output, generate and revalidate a fixed-field failure envelope, upload it, then preserve the failed compatibility outcome.

findings.description: Evidence validation accepted incomplete passing reports and could crash or echo rejected values.
findings.resolution: Bind unique required checks to surfaces, require assets/revisions/provenance/mutation completion, type-guard semantics, and emit only fixed schema errors.

findings.description: A mutation fixture without explicit authorization was silently ignored after network checks.
findings.resolution: Reject the mutation input before run ID creation or any network boundary.

findings.description: Manifest and asset responses were fully buffered before byte bounds were enforced.
findings.resolution: Stream decompressed response chunks and stop at per-document, cumulative, or deadline bounds.

findings.description: Secret-bearing workflow jobs used mutable action and uv references.
findings.resolution: Pin every action to a reviewed commit SHA and uv to an exact version.

findings.description: The manual release evidence validator did not require the stamp digest or served frontend provenance.
findings.resolution: Require the canonical stamp path/digest and matching served revision with verified detached-SHA provenance.

findings.description: Rollback uploads did not generate a revision stamp.
findings.resolution: Stamp the clean detached rollback SHA before Railway upload and require the reported identity.

findings.description: Implementation commits and review fixes exceeded declared package scopes and verification ownership.
findings.resolution: Move all release identity, CLI/browser, mutation/evidence, and integration files and focused gates into plan revision 3 locks and write scopes.

findings.description: Protected environment guidance omitted ref restrictions and self-approval controls.
findings.resolution: Require reviewed default/release refs, no self-approval, and no administrator bypass.
